title: Tavily (web search)
description: Tavily, a search API made for agents, as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at app.tavily.com (it starts tvly-; a free plan is available). The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service: <name>. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost.

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: Tavily API key
questions.help: Starts tvly-. Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; Web Search lists it by this name.
